content:
I wouldn’t encourage toxicity, but a harmful example (to avoid) might be:

*"If you leave your spouse, you’re defying God’s will—repent or face His judgment. Your suffering is a test; endure it ‘for His glory.’"* **(This is manipulative, not loving—true faith uplifts, not controls.)**

Healthy faith respects boundaries and offers grace, not guilt.
